title: Summit Gold Pricing Chart by Points Earned, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Chart.** The points a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement earned for Gold pricing are the points of every points accrual entry and every bonus entry posted to the agreement in the Gold earning window: the 12 calendar months up to and including the redemption date, each entry placed by its posting date. Those earned points set the Gold earning percentage of a Summit Gold status award:

| Points earned in the 12-month window | Gold earning percentage |
|---|---|
| 200000 or more | 94 percent |
| 100000 or more, and below 200000 | 97 percent |
| below 100000 | 100 percent (the full price) |

**How the percentage acts.** The Gold earning percentage multiplies the standard Gold award price, the tier's Summit Gold status-award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Accruals of 95000 points and bonuses of 5000 points in the window make 100000 earned points: 97 percent.
- Accruals of 99999 points and no bonus: 100 percent.
- Accruals of 190000 points and a bonus of 10000 points: 200000 earned points, 94 percent.
- Redemptions and expiries do not reduce the earned points; only accrual and bonus entries are counted.
